newsitem.title: CUBA: Rain causes damage in western Cuba.
newsitem.headline: Rain causes damage in western Cuba.

text.p: Several dozen homes were damaged in western Cuba when heavy rains caused by a tropical depression spread from eastern and central areas of the island, state media said Tuesday.
The national news agency AIN said that in western Matanzas provinces, 20 homes were destroyed and 100 were damaged. Two homes were destroyed in Havana and 28 damaged.
The weather in Havana Tuesday was overcast but dry, although more rain was forecast.
Since rain hit eastern Cuba last week, hundreds of people have been evacuated from their homes for brief periods as a precaution or because their houses were flooded.
They included 84 foreign tourists in the resort of Varadero east of Havana who were moved Monday to another hotel at the resort after a service block in their own hotel was flooded.
The rain has ended a long period of unusually dry weather in Cuba and authorities say it is good for crops and reservoirs.
